scenes.headline: How a guessing game becomes an RL environment
scenes.sub: GeoGuessr in OpenEnv, a Qwen3.5-4B with LoRA, and GRPO.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Camellia! Here's how a street-view guessing game becomes a training ground.

scenes.text: A guess is scored by its distance from the truth: continuous, verifiable, no judge to game. That makes the game trainable.
scenes.say: The idea: a guess is scored by its distance from the truth. Verifiable, with no judge to game.

steps.say: Each episode drops the model at a street panorama. One view, no metadata.

steps.note: place_pin says what is there, never how close
steps.say: It can look, zoom and move, at a small cost. A pin says what's at a spot, never whether it's close.
Submit guess ends the episode. The score comes from the true distance, revealed only then.
The trainer runs eight rollouts of one task, and nudges the LoRA toward the better ones.

left.title: The game's curve
items: Subtracts action cost, floors at zero
left.say: The game's curve subtracts cost, then floors at zero. Seventy-seven of two hundred replays scored exactly zero, near misses and wild ones alike.

right.title: The trainer's curve
right.say: The trainer adds a slower decay and multiplies by cost, so bad guesses stay ordered.

scenes.title: The instability that did the work
scenes.say: Now the part that looked like a bug.

parts.note: a rollout's reward against its group's
parts.say: A rollout's advantage is its reward minus the group's mean,

parts.note: one task per step: spread near 0.016
parts.say: divided by the group's spread. With one task per step, that spread shrinks as the policy grows confident,
so the same gap gets pushed about sixty times harder. Turning that off kept a fifth of the gain.

scenes.title: Median error on 200 held-out tasks
scenes.note: turns fell 6.7 to 1.1, under an eval protocol it never trained on
scenes.say: Median error fell from twelve hundred twenty-six kilometres to six hundred sixty-two, as turns fell from six point seven to one point one.

scenes.text: On this reward, the biggest win was not being catastrophically wrong, so the model learned to glance once and commit.

recap: Tools that never hint at the answer
A reward curve that keeps bad guesses ordered
One task per step amplifies the signal
scenes.say: To recap: tools that never hint, a reward that keeps bad guesses ordered, and a signal that amplifies itself.
